subject: vt-dy
title: (R)VT.DY.------POST.
description: Diagram in WI-26, paired with v1-p310-1. (R)VT-DY — the reality of vibrational dynamics — is crossed with POST (postulation). This is structurally the *same crossing* as the CODE/v1-p14 example schematic from Braxton's pedagogical opening, returning here in the WI context — meaning Braxton is staging the question of how the reality of vibrational dynamics gets postulated in the white-improvisor's situation specifically. VT-DY → PRI-VT-TD (primary vibrational tendencies) → SI (source initiation) → POST (the crossing) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), POST → AFTD (affinity tendencies), POST → LANG-DY (language dynamics). LANG-DY → RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and LANG-DY → INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) → AFI (affinity insight). Structural argument: the reality of vibrational dynamics flows through primary vibrational tendencies → source initiation → postulation as a single chain. From postulation, three parallel outputs emerge: progressional continuance (the diachronic axis), affinity tendencies (the affinity axis), and language dynamics (the conceptual axis). Language dynamics then bifurcates into reality alignment and individual dynamics → affinity insight. The diagram thus stages the white improvisor's *opportunity*: if the source initiation grounding is real (i.e., not merely conceptual), the postulation chain produces all three downstream — but if source initiation is merely pedagogical/source-transfer, the chain breaks at postulation and language dynamics dominates without primary-vibrational-tendency grounding. The pedagogical example from p14 is here re-asked with explicit social-political stakes.
